items.mainDefect: Anonymous Authenticate now returns ErrDeviceLimitReached and fails authentication, but its callers (the authn service and HTTP handlers) still expect anonymous auth to always succeed and were not updated to handle the refusal.

secondary.defect: Device tagging now runs synchronously on the request context, so every anonymous authentication waits on the CountDevices and UPDATE/INSERT calls instead of the previous best-effort background goroutine.

items.mainDefect: ProvideAnonDeviceService's third parameter changed from AnonStore to db.DB, so any remaining caller or wire binding that still passes AnonStore will fail to compile or fail dependency injection.

secondary.defect: Because the service now takes db.DB instead of AnonStore, tests can no longer inject a fake or mock AnonStore.
